mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (create_time, creator, is_deleted, update_time, updater, quantity, business_id, customer_id, food_id, remarks) VALUES (#{createTime}, #{creator}, #{isDeleted}, #{updateTime}, #{updater}, #{quantity}, #{businessId}, #{customerId}, #{foodId}, #{remarks})
mapper.update: UPDATE cart SET remarks = #{remarks}, update_time = NOW() WHERE customer_id = #{userId} AND business_id = #{businessId} AND is_deleted = 0
